name: Gingerbread French Toast
description: A festive breakfast recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Whisk egg, milk, molasses and spices.
Dip bread into mixture on both sides.
Cook in a buttered skillet for 3 minutes per side.
Serve with maple syrup.

name: White Chocolate Peppermint Mocha
description: A festive drinks recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Warm milk and melt white chocolate into it.
Stir in peppermint extract.
Pour over espresso.
Top with whipped cream.

name: Cranberry Brie Puff Pastry Bites
description: A festive appetizer recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F.
Cut pastry into 12 squares and press into mini muffin cups.
Add brie, cranberry sauce and rosemary.
Bake 15–18 minutes until puffed and golden.

name: Brown Butter Chai Snowball Cookies
description: A festive dessert recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Brown butter in a saucepan and cool until soft.
Beat with sugar, then mix in flour, nuts and spice.
Roll into small balls and bake at 350°F for 12–14 minutes.
Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar.

name: Orange Cardamom Hot Chocolate
description: A festive drinks recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Heat milk with cocoa, chocolate and cardamom.
Whisk until smooth.
Stir in orange zest.
Pour into a mug and serve warm.

name: Christmas Tree Pesto Pull-Apart Bread
description: A festive appetizer recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F.
Cut pastry into two matching tree shapes; spread pesto and cheese between layers.
Cut horizontal branches and twist each branch.
Brush with egg and bake 18–22 minutes.

name: Eggnog Cinnamon Roll Pancakes
description: A festive breakfast recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Mix pancake mix, eggnog and egg into a batter.
Combine butter, sugar and cinnamon for the swirl.
Pour small pancakes into a greased pan and swirl cinnamon mixture over each.
Cook both sides until set.

name: Maple Roasted Carrots with Pomegranate
description: A festive side dish recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F.
Toss carrots with oil, maple syrup and thyme.
Roast 25–30 minutes until tender.
Sprinkle with pomegranate seeds before serving.

name: Pistachio Rose Shortbread Stars
description: A festive dessert recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; mix in flour, pistachios and rosewater.
Chill dough for 20 minutes.
Roll out and cut into stars.
Bake at 350°F for 11–13 minutes.

name: Toasted Marshmallow Gingerbread Latte
description: A festive drinks recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Warm milk with molasses and spices.
Froth and pour over espresso.
Toast marshmallows carefully under a broiler or with a kitchen torch.
Add marshmallows on top.

name: Cranberry Orange Ricotta Pancakes
description: A festive breakfast recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Whisk ricotta, egg, milk and orange zest.
Fold in flour, baking powder and cranberries.
Spoon batter onto a lightly oiled skillet.
Cook until golden on both sides.

name: Creamy Roasted Chestnut Soup
description: A festive dinner recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Soften chopped onion in butter.
Add chestnuts and broth; simmer 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in cream and nutmeg.
Warm gently and season to taste.

name: Hot Honey Halloumi Holiday Skewers
description: A festive appetizer recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Cut halloumi and vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Thread onto skewers and brush lightly with oil.
Grill or pan-sear until golden.
Drizzle with honey mixed with chili and lemon.

name: Spiced Pear and Brie Grilled Cheese
description: A festive lunch recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Thinly slice the pear.
Layer brie and pear on bread, then drizzle with honey and cinnamon.
Butter the outside of the sandwich.
Toast in a skillet until golden and cheese melts.

name: Red Velvet Crinkle Cookies
description: A festive dessert recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Mix flour, cocoa and baking powder.
Whisk egg, sugar, oil and coloring, then combine with dry ingredients.
Chill dough for 30 minutes and roll into balls coated in powdered sugar.
Bake at 350°F for 10–12 minutes.

name: Butternut Squash and Sage Gnocchi
description: A festive dinner recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Roast squash at 425°F for 20–25 minutes.
Boil gnocchi according to package directions.
Brown butter with sage and garlic in a skillet.
Toss gnocchi and squash in the butter and top with parmesan.

name: Peppermint Bark Brownies
description: A festive dessert recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F and line a small baking pan.
Whisk melted butter, sugar and eggs; fold in cocoa and flour.
Add chocolate chips and bake 20–25 minutes.
Cool and sprinkle with crushed peppermint candy.

name: Rosemary Garlic Star Bread
description: A festive appetizer recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F.
Spread garlic-rosemary butter between two pastry rounds.
Cut radial strips around a center circle and twist into a star.
Brush with egg and bake 20–25 minutes.

name: Baked Apple Pie Overnight Oats
description: A festive breakfast recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Mix oats, milk, yogurt, cinnamon and maple syrup in a jar.
Fold in diced apple.
Refrigerate overnight.
Warm gently or serve chilled with extra cinnamon.

name: Cranberry Orange Sparkling Mocktail
description: A festive drinks recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Fill a glass with ice.
Add cranberry, orange and lime juices.
Top with sparkling water and stir.
Garnish with cranberries and rosemary.

name: Mini Mushroom Wellington Bites
description: A festive appetizer recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F.
Cook mushrooms and shallot in oil until dry; season with thyme.
Place spoonfuls on pastry squares and fold into parcels.
Brush with egg and bake 18–22 minutes.

name: Salted Caramel Gingerbread Cheesecake Cups
description: A festive dessert recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Beat cream cheese, yogurt, sugar and spices until smooth.
Layer crushed cookies and cheesecake filling in two cups.
Drizzle with caramel.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

name: Hot Chocolate Tiramisu
description: A festive dessert recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Beat mascarpone with whipped cream and sugar.
Quickly dip ladyfingers into cooled cocoa.
Layer dipped biscuits and cream in two small dishes.
Chill 2 hours and dust with cocoa before serving.

name: Sticky Toffee Pudding with Brown Butter Sauce
description: A festive dessert recipe featuring seasonal flavors and a cozy holiday twist.
instructions: Soak dates in boiling water and baking soda for 10 minutes.
Mash dates, then mix with flour, sugar, melted butter and egg.
Bake in greased ramekins at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.
Brown sauce butter, stir in sugar and cream, simmer briefly and pour over puddings.
